payload.name: Implicit affective preference for visual symmetry
payload.fact: Visual symmetry elicits an automatic affective response that is predicted by the speed at which patterns can be identified.
payload.boundary: Implicit preferences were always predicted by the speed at which patterns could be identified.

provenance.title: Implicit affective evaluation of visual symmetry.
provenance.quote_or_locus: In some cases these results were not in agreement with verbally reported preferences, but implicit preferences were always predicted by the speed at which patterns could be identified. We conclude that the IAT can unearth an automatic affective response produced by perceptual fluency
